commands.name: skills_sync_all_sources
helperChain: skills_sync_all_sources<R> moves owned AppHandle, work_path and progress_id into awaited tauri::async_runtime::spawn_blocking; ProgressReporter is constructed inside the worker
skills_sync_all_sources_impl ensures defaults, saves defaults, and captures source generations and canonical paths under the short registry guard inside that worker
skills_sync_all_sources_blocking processes the immutable snapshot set and calls sync_source_transaction with expected identity for each item

sync_source_transaction uses nonqueued source/worktree reservations, validates current generation/path before network and fresh guarded commit, and returns skills plus the timestamp from that exact commit
Batch Git pull uses fixed argv; each success persists independently; busy, failed and successful results each consume one snapshot identity

cargo check -p maru-cli passes against the shared store module

processingCaller.payload: total = results.length = succeeded + failed + skipped; skipped entries are not success/failure and have no new timestamp; partial failure reasons and successful sibling data are retained
processingCaller.terminalNoticeOwner: src/lib/skillOperations.ts::startSkillOperation publishes exactly one deduplicated OperationNotice; errorStore retains concurrent notices until dismissal; App renders its existing toast region
processingCaller.lifetime: operation promise and progress listener belong to the workspace/source-keyed module store, not a component subscription; late registration is disposed and listener setup failure does not suppress mutation settlement
processingCaller.viewPublication: SkillsTab subscribes to initiating workspace progress; createSkillViewScope guards refresh responses with workspace, monotonic view generation and request sequence, including A -> B -> A
processingCaller.retry: manual explicit action only; duplicate source/batch starts return the existing promise; busy batch sources are skipped while independent work proceeds
processingCaller.successRetention: SkillOperation.result retains the payload; component refresh is viewScope.request-guarded; optimistic removal guarded by captured isCurrent() closure
processingCaller.failureReasons: explicit classify reason strings (per-item failure messages joined); built-in path merges syncAllComplete summary with per-source errors and detects skills_source_stale

evidence.runtimeProof: Actual async command wrapper with Tauri MockRuntime AppHandle; separately hold defaults and per-source work, require a yielding same-runtime probe before release, and assert the held worker thread differs from the invoking async thread. Always release barriers before assertions. This is boundary proof, not final saturation/latency evidence.
evidence.verificationCorrection: The initial direct native runner invocation reused the prior binary and timed out; it is not counted as passing. Rebuilt using the Makefile native frontend, build.rs touch, and cargo --features native-e2e sequence before successful focused verification. A later rebuilt run passed after the driver replayed a timed-out script. The spec now returns diagnostics at 25 seconds (before the driver timeout) and asserts observed progress plus terminal success notice and actual persisted Git effects, without assuming final progress-event ordering relative to invoke settlement.
evidence.safety: No live credentials or services, dependency package, retry framework, persisted job center, runtime test IPC bridge, navigation side effect, permission bypass, push or release. Tauri test support is dev-only. Final production artifact isolation and native saturation/navigation scenarios remain 08-27/28; cross-domain path integration remains 08-29.
